name: i3
description: Tiling window manager - can be logged into instead of the default xfce desktop environment.

name: Flatpak with flathub repository
description: Flatpak virtualisation software with the remote flathub repository set up

name: .bashrc
description: Bash script that runs when the bash terminal starts. Can be used for configuration and customisation

name: bash aliases
description: A selection of bash alias scripts that provide shortcuts for commands to a seperate name

name: .xinputrc
description: Bash script that sets up the input methods for the operating system

name: .Xresources
description: Bash script that sets up the X11 resource configs - e.g. fonts and cursor

description: i3 configuration file. Can be used for configuration and customisation
